title: Proper morphisms: compact supports equal direct image
statement:
For a proper
$f:X\to Y$ and the canonical identification
$Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*$ of
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] (the compactification
$j=\operatorname{id}$, $p=f$), the map $\operatorname{Ex}_!$
of [def-cbc-exchange-map] is the proper-base-change exchange map
of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]; consequently the
compact-support base change of
[thm-cbc-finite-torsion] specializes to proper base change for
proper $f$.

proof.text: Use the identity-open compactification in [def-cbc-exchange-map]. Compare the levelwise derived identity-open adjunction isomorphism with the identity isomorphism shId of the derived compact-support formalism: their conjugates agree, since on the localization functor Qh the derived unit is the levelwise unit and the underived leftAdjointIdIso is conjugate to the inverse pullback identity. Then baseChange_id_vert cancels the identity-open factor in shriekBaseChange. Naturality of the proper exchange in [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] gives the required identity for the two identity-open compactifications.

The identity-open compactification of the base-changed proper map refines the literal pullback compactification via the latter open immersion. Its refinement square is cartesian because both vertical identity maps are isomorphisms. Write the canonical comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-compactification-independence] using this refinement and the identity refinement. The refinement compatibility of the exchange construction [def-cbc-exchange-map] identifies the identity-open exchange with the literal-pullback exchange followed by this canonical comparison. The derivedPlusFormalism_shriekIso comparison identifies this formalism comparison with the specified candidate comparison. Compose with the identity-open identification on the base-changed scheme.

A finite commutative coefficient ring is additively torsion. Apply the finite-ring form isIso_baseChange_of_isProper_of_isAddTorsion_ring of [thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below] to the supplied cartesian square. The equality baseChange_eq_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus identifies that invertible transformation with the specified proper derived exchange. Pair this invertibility with the equality already proved.

proof_origin.place: Identity-open normalization proof, expanded using the existing compact-support formalism identity/refinement laws and the ordinary proper-base-change theorem.

lean.note: Section 1(B): the recorded Nonempty isomorphism neither specifies the canonical identity-open identification nor states coincidence of Ex_! with the proper-base-change exchange. This module constructs the identity-open identification from the specified open adjunction, constructs its arbitrary-candidate and base-change transports using the recorded canonical comparison, and states equality of the two exchanges and invertibility. The pro-etale identity-open identification is constructed by the identical adjunction formula for the item normalization.
